creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling feedback, 2026-10-17, Mac, all on 0.16.1-dev, which already had ce23494e (Claude Code waiting on its background shells reads waiting) and 61045758. The maker watch (`crates/muster-daemon/src/messages/makers.rs`) told a maker "<helper> went idle without posting to you since it went to work ..." in four cases where the helper was fine:

- A Claude Code helper started a 10-minute run with background Bash and ended its turn to wait for it. Its footer said "1 shell still running", yet its row read `idle` and the notice fired 32 s after it went to work.
- A worker ran `"$MUSTER_DAEMON" report --waiting "<what>"`, as the SessionStart hook says, before ending each turn to wait on its own background build. Its maker still got the notice twice in one assignment. A declared wait should hold the pane at `waiting` until the wait ends.
- A helper under Claude Code Monitor tools woke for a few seconds per monitor event and went idle again: three notices in ten minutes, while `muster window` showed the pane `waiting ... on its background shells`.
- The maker ran `muster pane compact --pane <helper>` on an idle helper. The compaction counted as going to work, so the helper going idle after it raised the notice (twice, two helpers). A turn Muster typed at the maker's request is not the helper going to work.

`need()` in makers.rs raises the notice only on `Activity::Idle`, so in the first three cases the helper's activity read idle while the screen or a declaration said waiting. Guess, unconfirmed: the adapter's turn-end report outranks both. The fourth case is the watch itself: any `Working` starts a stretch of work.
title: A helper that declared a wait, or was only compacted, is reported idle without posting
